title: Apartment for rent in Tay Ho: prices and areas (2026)
description: Tay Ho apartment rents by area and type, with Muaban.net asking prices read on 19 November 2026, the new ward names and what to check before you sign.
h1: Apartment for rent in Tay Ho: what it costs, where to look and what to check
intro: To rent an apartment in Tay Ho, Hanoi's West Lake area, choose between mini-apartments, tower flats around Ciputra and Xuan La, or serviced apartments near the lake. Since 1 July 2025 its addresses fall in Tay Ho, Phu Thuong, Hong Ha, Ba Dinh, Xuan Dinh or Nghia Do ward. Rents depend mostly on the building and the size. On 19 November 2026, the dearest live Tay Ho asking rents on Muaban.net were about five times the cheapest.
keyPoints: On 19 November 2026, live Tay Ho listings on Muaban.net asked from {{vnd:5000000}} a month (a 25 m² mini-apartment off Vong Thi, Thuy Khue) to {{vnd:25000000}} (a 92 m² duplex at PentStudio Westlake, Phu Thuong).

The building and the size drive the price. On the same day, an 81 m² two-bedroom in the CT13B block on Vo Chi Cong street, Phu Thuong, asked {{vnd:11000000}}, while a 45 m² one-bedroom at Sun Grand City on Thuy Khue asked {{vnd:17000000}}.

Since 1 July 2025 the old Tay Ho district has been spread over **Tay Ho**, **Phu Thuong**, **Hong Ha**, **Ba Dinh**, **Xuan Dinh** and **Nghia Do** wards (Resolution 1656/NQ-UBTVQH15). Copy the address into your lease exactly as it appears on the landlord's papers: papers issued before 1 July 2025 still carry the old ward and district, so the new ward may not be on them.
Many agency listings aimed at foreigners quote rent in US dollars and often don't say what the rent covers. Ask in writing about the management fee, internet, cleaning, electricity and water.
Declaring a foreign tenant's stay to the ward police is the landlord's duty by law, within 12 hours of your arrival (24 hours in remote areas).

When we checked on 19 November 2026, the [homes for rent on eno.vn](/c/rentals) included 96 Hanoi listings from official partner [GoPlus](/goplus), 25 of them in Tay Ho ward. One was a 22 m² studio at {{vnd:4800000}} a month with a one-month deposit.

sections.title: Where to look for an apartment for rent in Tay Ho, Hanoi

blocks.text: For an apartment in Tay Ho, most people choose between three parts of the old district: the lake-side lanes around Xuan Dieu, To Ngoc Van and Quang An; the towers of Phu Thuong and Ciputra in the north-west; and the Xuan La and Lac Long Quan stretch near Lotte Mall. Each part tends to have its own kind of home, so first decide what kind of home you want, then the street.

blocks.text: Hanoi Real Estate's Vietnamese Tay Ho pages showed 786 listings on 19 November 2026. Vietlong Housing names Xuan Dieu, To Ngoc Van, Dang Thai Mai and Au Co among its Tay Ho listings. LivingHaNoi's Tay Ho page lists its prices in US dollars. Agencies like these mostly list furnished homes for foreign tenants. Local classified sites such as Muaban.net carry more ordinary flats in the towers.

sections.title: How much is an apartment for rent in Tay Ho?

blocks.text: On 19 November 2026, live Tay Ho apartment listings on Muaban.net asked between {{vnd:5000000}} and {{vnd:25000000}} a month. The building and the size made the biggest difference: the cheapest were mini-apartments and older flats, and the dearest were large flats and duplexes in the newer towers. These are asking prices from one site on one day, so take them as a guide, not as what people actually agreed to pay.

blocks.text: Agencies such as Vietlong Housing list furnished homes aimed at foreign tenants, and their prices generally start higher than many Muaban.net rents. Compare what each rent covers before you compare the figures.

blocks.title: Dollar prices
blocks.text: Many agency listings for foreigners in Tay Ho quote rent in US dollars. Inside Vietnam, though, prices may not be listed or paid in foreign currency except where the State Bank of Vietnam allows it, under [Article 22 of the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange as amended in 2013](https://hethongphapluat.com/phap-lenh-sua-doi-phap-lenh-ngoai-hoi-nam-2013/dieu-1), and [Decree 340/2025/ND-CP](https://ketoananpha.vn/nghi-dinh-340-2025-nd-cp) fines both paying and pricing in foreign currency against the rules (Article 27). So the lease states the monthly rent in đồng.

sections.title: Is Tay Ho still a district?

blocks.text: No. Since 1 July 2025 Vietnam has had no district level, so the old Tay Ho district is gone. Its area is now spread over six wards under [Resolution 1656/NQ-UBTVQH15](https://english.luatvietnam.vn/resolution-no-1656-nq-ubtvqh15-dated-june-16-2025-of-the-national-assembly-standing-committee-on-the-reorganization-of-commune-level-administrative-403020-doc1.html) of the National Assembly Standing Committee, dated 16 June 2025. Most of it is in **Tay Ho ward** and **Phu Thuong ward**, and the rest is in Hong Ha, Ba Dinh, Xuan Dinh and Nghia Do wards. Listings and people still say "Tay Ho" for the whole area.

items: **Tay Ho ward** took all of the old Buoi ward, parts of Phu Thuong and Xuan La, and what remained of Nhat Tan, Quang An, Tu Lien, Yen Phu, Nghia Do and Thuy Khue after the neighbouring wards took their shares.
**Phu Thuong ward** took what remained of the old Phu Thuong ward and parts of the old Dong Ngac, Xuan La, Xuan Dinh and Xuan Tao wards.
**Hong Ha ward** took the parts of Nhat Tan, Phu Thuong, Quang An, Tu Lien and Yen Phu by the river, and **Ba Dinh ward** took part of Thuy Khue.
**Nghia Do ward** took part of the old Xuan La ward, and **Xuan Dinh ward** took what remained of Xuan La.

blocks.text: So an address listed as "Quang An, Tay Ho" could now be in Tay Ho ward or in Hong Ha ward, and one listed as "Xuan La, Tay Ho" could be in Tay Ho, Phu Thuong, Nghia Do or Xuan Dinh ward. Copy the address into the lease exactly as it appears on the landlord's papers for the flat. Papers issued before 1 July 2025 still carry the old ward and district, so the new ward may not be on them. The same address goes on your bills, and its ward police are the ones the landlord declares your stay to.

sections.title: Renting in Tay Ho: what to check before you sign

blocks.text: The asking rent in Tay Ho often isn't the whole monthly cost. Hanoi Real Estate says the rent may include the management fee, internet and cable TV, depending on each place's policy, and advises confirming the charges before a viewing or a deposit. Vietlong Housing says most of its homes come fully furnished, with cleaning and 24/7 security. Neither site gives a standard deposit or lease length, so ask about both for each home.

items.title: List what the rent covers
items.text: Ask about the building's management fee, internet, cleaning, laundry and parking, and whether you pay electricity and water at the official rate or at a rate the landlord sets.

items.title: Check the address
items.text: Copy the address into the lease exactly as it appears on the landlord's papers for the flat. Papers issued before 1 July 2025 still carry the old ward and district, so the new ward (Tay Ho, Phu Thuong, Hong Ha, Ba Dinh, Xuan Dinh or Nghia Do) may not be on them.

items.title: Agree the deposit and notice period in writing
items.text: Write down how much the deposit is, when it comes back and what can be taken off it. Our [guide to rental deposits in Vietnam](/rental-deposit-vietnam) covers the usual arguments over deposits.

items.title: Expect the landlord to declare your stay
items.text: Declaring a foreign tenant's stay is the landlord's duty by law. According to [DH Tax Law](https://dhtaxlaw.com.vn/ca-nhan-cho-nguoi-nuoc-ngoai-thue-nha-co-phai-dang-ky-kinh-doanh-khong-co-can-thong-bao-tai-khoan-ngan-hang-khong?lang=us), the landlord declares it to the ward police (Công an phường) where the home is, within 12 hours of your arrival, or 24 hours in remote areas, either online or on a paper declaration form. Give the landlord your passport details when they ask on moving day. See [renting an apartment in Vietnam as a foreigner](/renting-an-apartment-vietnam-foreigner) for this, viewings and bills.

items.title: Photograph the flat at handover
items.text: Photograph each room, the furniture and the meter readings on the day you get the keys, and send them to the landlord in the same chat you used to agree the lease.

blocks.title: Expired listings
blocks.text: On 19 November 2026, the first page of Muaban.net's Tay Ho results showed 20 listings, and 7 of the 20 were already marked expired. Before you pay anything to hold a home, check that it is still available and that the person you are dealing with has the right to rent it out.

sections.title: Can you find a Tay Ho apartment for rent on eno.vn?

blocks.text: Yes. When we checked on 19 November 2026, the [homes for rent on eno.vn](/c/rentals) included 96 Hanoi listings from [GoPlus](/goplus), an official eno.vn partner, and 25 of them were in phường Tây Hồ (Tay Ho ward). One was a 22 m² studio in Tay Ho ward at {{vnd:4800000}} a month, with a deposit of one month's rent. GoPlus answers questions about its own homes in eno.vn chat. To ask whether any home is still free, message the landlord, agent or partner in eno.vn chat; on a linked listing, the button opens the original posting on its source site.

Compare the GoPlus rents with the Muaban.net and agency prices above, and run through the checks before you sign. If you are still choosing between Hanoi and Saigon, our guide to [Hanoi vs Ho Chi Minh City](/teach-in-vietnam/hanoi-vs-ho-chi-minh-city-for-teachers) compares them, and for Saigon the [HCMC Rent Index](/hcmc-rent-index) shows median asking rents by district for the homes listed on eno.vn. You can furnish a home from eno.vn's [furniture and appliances](/c/furniture-appliances) listings.

faqs.q: How much is an apartment for rent in Tay Ho?
faqs.a: Apartments in Tay Ho, Hanoi, asked very different rents in live Muaban.net listings on 19 November 2026. Mini-apartments off Vong Thi in Thuy Khue were at the bottom, and large duplexes at PentStudio Westlake in Phu Thuong were at the top, about five times as much. The building and the size made the biggest difference. Agencies' furnished homes for foreign tenants generally cost more. The page above has the figures.

faqs.q: What are the best areas for an apartment for rent in Tay Ho Hanoi?
faqs.a: There are three main parts of Tay Ho. The lake-side lanes around Xuan Dieu, To Ngoc Van and Quang An are where you find serviced apartments and lake-view flats. Phu Thuong and Ciputra have large flats in newer towers such as Sunshine Golden River and Lac Hong Westlake. Xuan La and Lac Long Quan, near Lotte Mall, have tower flats and studios in buildings such as D'El Dorado and 6th Elements.

faqs.q: Is Tay Ho still a district in Hanoi?
faqs.a: Tay Ho stopped being a district on 1 July 2025, when Vietnam abolished the district level. Under Resolution 1656/NQ-UBTVQH15, the old Tay Ho district mainly became Tay Ho ward and Phu Thuong ward. Hong Ha ward took the riverside parts, Ba Dinh ward took part of Thuy Khue, and Nghia Do and Xuan Dinh wards took parts of the old Xuan La. People and rental listings still use Tay Ho as the area name.

faqs.q: Does rent for a Tay Ho apartment include utilities?
faqs.a: What the rent covers in a Tay Ho apartment depends on the landlord. Hanoi Real Estate says rent may include the management fee, internet and cable TV, depending on each place's policy. Vietlong Housing says most of its Tay Ho homes come fully furnished, with cleaning and 24/7 security. Ask about electricity and water separately, including the rate per unit, and get the answers written into the lease.

faqs.q: Is renting in Tay Ho priced in dollars?
faqs.a: Many agency listings for foreign tenants in Tay Ho quote rent in US dollars, while local sites such as Muaban.net list Tay Ho rents in Vietnamese đồng. Inside Vietnam, prices may not be listed or paid in foreign currency except where the State Bank of Vietnam allows it, under Article 22 of the amended Ordinance on Foreign Exchange, and Decree 340/2025/ND-CP fines breaches. A Tay Ho lease therefore states the monthly rent in đồng.

faqs.q: Can I find an apartment for rent in Tay Ho on eno.vn?
faqs.a: On 19 November 2026, eno.vn had apartments for rent in Tay Ho. GoPlus, an official eno.vn partner, listed 96 Hanoi homes on eno.vn, 25 of them in Tay Ho ward, including a 22 m² studio with a deposit of one month's rent. GoPlus answers questions about its own homes in eno.vn chat. Compare the GoPlus rents with local sites such as Muaban.net before you choose.

faqs.q: What should a foreigner check before renting a Tay Ho apartment?
faqs.a: Before renting in Tay Ho, a foreign tenant should list everything the rent covers and agree the deposit and notice period in writing. Copy the address into the lease exactly as it appears on the landlord's papers; papers issued before 1 July 2025 may still show the old ward and district. By law the landlord must declare a foreign tenant's stay to the ward police within 12 hours of arrival. Photograph the flat and the meter readings when you get the keys.
